about.title: Informations
about.subtitle: About me
description: I am a Full Stack Web Developer specialized in designing and developing B2B SaaS platforms in production environments.
My approach combines the engineering of robust backend architectures with the creation of fluid, data-driven and accessible user interfaces.

I have over 2 years of commercial experience focused on Component-Driven Architecture, web performance optimization (SSR/ISR) and complex data flow management. Used to operating in fast-paced Agile (Scrum) teams, where software quality is ensured through Clean Code principles and constructive Code Reviews.
Open to international relocation and oriented toward continuous growth, with increasing interest in the DevOps world and large-scale software engineering practices.

Established CI/CD pipelines on Bitbucket with automated deploy to AWS, reducing release time
Containerized services with Docker and collaborated in Agile Scrum sprints with code reviews
Applied WCAG accessibility standards across all frontend interfaces
Worked in Agile Scrum environment with sprint planning, daily standups and retrospectives

Developed frontend with Vue.js, JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS in a fast-paced 3-person startup team

projects.title: Projects
projects.task_manager_app_description: A React Native mobile app for task management with JWT authentication, swipe gestures, dark/light theme and bilingual support. Built with Expo, TypeScript and connected to the Task Manager API backend.
projects.task_manager_desciption: A RESTful API for task management built with Node.js, Express, and TypeScript. It features JWT authentication, robust input validation using Zod, and a PostgreSQL database managed via Prisma ORM. The project follows clean architecture principles and is fully containerized with Docker for seamless deployment.
projects.portfolio_v2_description: The current version of my portfolio, built using Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. It leverages Static Site Generation (SSG) for optimal performance and next-intl for multi-language support. The application adopts a strictly component-driven architecture and includes native dark/light mode support.
projects.portfolio_v1_description: My very first developer portfolio, built from scratch using vanilla JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3. I implemented a custom internationalization system (IT/EN) using data attributes before working with dedicated i18n libraries—a logical challenge that laid the groundwork for the current Next.js version.
projects.flutter_description: A Human-Computer Interaction project focused on digital well-being: a hybrid mobile app developed with Flutter that combines an anti-distraction screen locker with music playback. When faced with OS-level system restrictions, I pivoted the technical approach toward a timer-based focus mode while preserving access to emergency calls.
